question: Where is the Indian naval air station INS Baaz located?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Great Nicobar Island**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• INS Baaz is located on the **Great Nicobar Island**, which is the southernmost island of the Andaman and Nicobar archipelago.
 
• It was commissioned on **31st July 2012** as a naval air station to enhance surveillance and operational capabilities in the Indian Ocean Region (IOR).
 
• The station is strategically located near the **Six Degree Channel**, a vital sea lane through which significant global trade passes.
 
• INS Baaz is pivotal for India’s **maritime security** and helps monitor the movement of ships and submarines in the region.
 
• The air station supports operations of aircraft such as the Dornier and helicopters, and it is capable of enabling future expansion for larger aircraft.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Andaman and Nicobar Islands**

 
 
• The Andaman and Nicobar Islands are a group of 572 islands located in the Bay of Bengal.
 
• They serve as India’s easternmost boundary and are of strategic importance for maritime trade and security.
 
• The islands act as a natural outpost for monitoring the **Malacca Strait**, one of the world's busiest shipping lanes.
 
 
 
• **Six Degree Channel**
 
 
• It is also known as the Great Channel and lies between the Great Nicobar Island and the Indonesian island of Sumatra.
 
• This channel is approximately 10 degrees north of the equator and is a crucial shipping route connecting the Indian Ocean to the Pacific Ocean.
 
 
 
• **Indian Naval Air Stations**
 
 
• Indian Naval Air Stations provide logistical and operational support for the Indian Navy’s air assets.
 
• Other key air stations include INS Hansa in Goa and INS Rajali in Tamil Nadu.
 
 
 
• **Strategic Importance of INS Baaz**
 
 
• The station enhances India’s ability to secure its Exclusive Economic Zone (EEZ) and monitor the **Indo-Pacific region**.
 
• It plays a key role in disaster relief operations, search and rescue missions, and maritime domain awareness.
